steps.title: PostgreSQL Documents RLS Enabled
steps.description: Verify doc.documents has RLS enabled (FORCE deferred pending DDL approval)
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'doc' AND c.relname = 'documents' AND c.relrowsecurity = true

steps.title: PostgreSQL Stage Requirements RLS Forced
steps.description: Verify stage_document_requirements has RLS enabled and FORCED
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'doc' AND c.relname = 'stage_document_requirements' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true
